name: Arcane Harmony
description: Fuels the destructive power of your group members, allowing them to strike with Arcane Harmony Effect II, which deals 20480 damage when they cast a damaging spell up to level 120, or a chance to strike with Arcane Harmony Strike II, which deals 18842 damage, when making melee attacks. Lasts for 12 seconds or until you have enhanced 4 spells.
